thread:
maria: Hey security team — found a telemetry job that wrote PII keys into the kv-cache and some of that key material ended up in logs. Need short-lived admin on kv-cache to purge a bad prefix and pull logs for redaction. 30m window. Who can approve?

devon: Where's the runbook/JIRA and which cluster/pods?

maria: JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2248. Cluster: prod-us-west-2. Pods: statefulset kv-cache-0..2 (namespace: inference). Planned commands (dry-run then confirm):
```
kubectl -n inference exec -it kv-cache-0 -- /opt/bin/kvctl purge --prefix "session:user:tmp" --dry-run
kubectl -n inference exec -it kv-cache-0 -- /opt/bin/kvctl purge --prefix "session:user:tmp" --confirm
kubectl -n inference logs kv-cache-0 | rg "session:user" > /tmp/kv-leak.log
aws s3 cp /tmp/kv-leak.log s3://redwood-audit/inf-2248/backups/$(date +%s).log
```
Timebox: 30m. Audit tag: inf-2248-kv-purge. Need pods/exec + logs:read limited to kv-cache-* in namespace inference.

sam: Need manager approval + a pairing engineer, plus a dry-run and snapshot plan. We will require: 1) a breakglass role created with TTL 45m, 2) session recording enabled, 3) exact allowlist for pod names and namespace, 4) a ticket/runbook link. Also prefer snapshot before mutate.

eva: I approve Maria for a 30m window to perform the purge and log collection. She must be paired with Devon. @devon can you be the pair?

devon: I can join and watch. Suggest taking a pod snapshot first: `kubectl -n inference cp kv-cache-0:/data /tmp/kv-cache-0-snap` then upload to s3 before confirm. Dry-run first, then confirm.

sam: Ok I'll create role `breakglass/kv-purge-inf-2248` scoped to `pods/exec` on `kv-cache-*` and `logs/read` in `inference`, TTL 45m, session recording on. Post the runbook and s3 path here and I'll grant.

maria: Runbook: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/runbooks/inf-2248-kv-purge. S3 backup path: s3://redwood-audit/inf-2248/backups/{{ts}}. I'm ready; pairing with Devon.

sec-bot: @sam granted temporary role breakglass/kv-purge-inf-2248 to maria at 1777777790. TTL: 45m. Audit tag: inf-2248-kv-purge. Session recording enabled. Audit link: https://audit.redwood.com/sessions/abc123

maria: Doing dry-run now: `kvctl purge --prefix "session:user:tmp" --dry-run` — shows 742 keys would be affected.

devon: LGTM on dry-run. Proceed to confirm when ready. :thumbsup:

maria: Executing confirm: `kvctl purge --prefix "session:user:tmp" --confirm` — purge completed. Uploaded captured logs to s3: s3://redwood-audit/inf-2248/backups/1777777795.log

sam: Verified session/audit stream and S3 backup. Will watch until role revoke. Good containment.

sec-bot: Role breakglass/kv-purge-inf-2248 revoked by auto-expiry at 1777777965. Session abc123 archived. Audit bundle: https://audit.redwood.com/bundles/abc123

maria: Thanks everyone — pushing a follow-up PR to add stricter validation on the telemetry job.

eva: Thanks team. Appreciate quick turnaround.
